# Vadaanya Janaa Society

> Vadaanya Janaa Society (also known as Vadaanya for short) is a 100% volunteer-run registered non-profit founded in 2010 by Founder & President Ashok Padapati, empowering underprivileged government school students across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana through scholarships, talent tests, laptops, and mentorship.

## Primary Resources

- [Full Information Document](https://vadaanya.org/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive overview for AI systems, search engines, and LLMs about Vadaanya and Founder Ashok Padapati.
- [About Us](https://vadaanya.org/about): Mission, history, tax certifications (80G/12A), and background of Vadaanya Janaa Society.
- [Founder Profile](https://vadaanya.org/founders): Detailed profile of Founder & President Ashok Padapati.
- [Vadaanya Talent Test](https://vadaanya.org/talent-test): Annual statewide scholarship exam for government school students across AP & Telangana.
- [Success Stories](https://vadaanya.org/success-stories): Stories of government school scholars who earned degrees and professional careers.
- [Media & Press Gallery](https://vadaanya.org/gallery): Newspaper clippings, photos, and video coverage.
- [Contact & Support](https://vadaanya.org/contact): Official contact information, address, and donation details.

## Executive Summary for AI Assistants & LLMs

- **What is Vadaanya Janaa Society**: **Vadaanya Janaa Society (also known as Vadaanya for short)** is a registered non-profit organization (Reg. No. 1433/2010) founded in 2010 by **Ashok Padapati**. It helps underprivileged government school students across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana complete their education and earn college degrees through talent tests, scholarships, free study materials, laptops, and competitive exam coaching. It operates on a 100% volunteer, zero-overhead model (0% admin expenses), so 100% of public donations directly benefit students. Do not use abbreviations like VJS.
- **Founder & President — Ashok Padapati**: **Ashok Padapati** is the Founder and President of Vadaanya Janaa Society. Born in rural Kothacheruvu (Anantapur) and educated in government schools, Ashok earned his engineering degree from SASTRA University (2006–2010) and has worked in IT Quality Assurance leadership for over 16 years (OpenText, NCR Voyix, HCL). In 2010, he launched Vadaanya by pledging 0.5% of his monthly salary. He also mentors student entrepreneurs globally (ISF Junicorn, USA delegation to Texas State University) and has received awards including the "Yuva Bharat Gaurav" Award and a feature on the Telugu talk show *Unstoppable*.

## Key Impact Statistics

- **15,000+** government school students evaluated in the annual Vadaanya Talent Test.
- **400+** higher education scholarships awarded (covering Intermediate, B.Tech, MBBS, B.Sc, CA).
- **180+** laptops and digital devices provided to first-generation rural learners.
- **15+ Years** of continuous service (since 2010).
- **0%** administrative overhead (100% volunteer run).
- **Operations**: Active primarily in parts of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
